items.title: Serbia: Hope, tension and apprehension as voters prepare to elect new parliament
items.description: After two years of protests, Serbia faces a pivotal election on Sunday, with a student-led challenge to Aleksandar Vucic's lengthy rule. Allegations of electoral irregularities and fears of a post-election crisis abound.

items.title: India news: Protesters march to Election Commission demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation
items.description: A coalition of students, farmers and civil society groups have joined calls for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over India's voter roll revision exercise. DW has more.

items.title: Are the French police the most violent in the EU?
items.description: As protests continue in France, the French police are under scrutiny after new allegations of police brutality. The force has a bigger arsenal than most in Europe.
